evidence.note: at_hash in the id_token does not match the hash computed from the access token presented. The signature, issuer, audience, time claims and nonce all pass.

output.fix: Make sure the access_token you validate is the one returned in the same token response as this id_token. Don't pair tokens from different responses or refreshes. Compute at_hash as the base64url of the left half of the SHA-256 digest of the ASCII access token, because RS256 uses the SHA-256 family. Keep the signature, nonce, issuer and audience checks as they are. If the pairing is correct and the mismatch persists, check whether a proxy or middleware is altering or re-issuing the access token.
